formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : SimpleGraph (Fin x1)) [x3 : DecidableRel x2.Adj] (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.IsMinimalMonoCircuit x1 x4 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 x4 = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun x2 ∅ → ∀ x7 < x4.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x4 x7).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∃ (x10 : Fin x1) (x11 : Fin x1), x2.Adj x10 x11 ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal x1 x4 x7 (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput x10 x11) = Bool.true ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun x1 (PEqualNP.CircuitMoves.eraseGate x1 x4 x7 (x1 + x4.gates.length)) (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput x10 x11) = Bool.false
plain_statement: In a least circuit of AND and OR gates (at most two inputs a gate) for a graph's edge function, every AND gate is true at the two-vertex input of some edge at which the circuit, with that gate replaced by false, is false.
title: A step toward: A step toward: On graphs with no triangle and no 4-cycle, some least AND/OR circuit of fan-in two for the edge function has every AND gate owning
